tools.name: liftbrain_search_recipes
tools.description: Searches LiftBrain's high-protein recipes. Each result has kcal, protein, fat and carbs per serving, the time and the page. Filter by words (dish or ingredient, in English), a tag, the most kcal or the least protein per serving; with no filters it lists them all.

tools.name: liftbrain_get_recipe
tools.description: A recipe in full: the ingredients in grams (raw meat, dry rice and pasta) scaled to the servings asked for, the method, kcal and macros per serving and per 100 g of the cooked dish, and the cooked weight. The values per 100 g are what liftlog_save_recipe takes.

tools.name: liftbrain_top_recipes
tools.description: The ten recipes LiftBrain's athletes rate best in the app (1 to 5 stars, weighed by how many rated), with their rating and kcal and macros per serving.

tools.name: liftbrain_list_guides
tools.description: LiftBrain's guides on strength training and nutrition (AI workout plans, progressive overload, protein, cutting and bulking, meal prep, counting calories), with their slug and page, in the language asked for.

tools.name: liftbrain_get_guide
tools.description: A guide's full text as Markdown, in the language asked for when it is translated, else in English.

tools.name: liftbrain_find_exercise
tools.description: Searches a free catalog of about 870 exercises by English words, e.g. "romanian deadlift" or "cable face pull": the muscles, equipment, level and step-by-step instructions.
